rationale: Folder-scoped CREATION is untested today. alerts-import.spec.js imports into the default folder without selecting a folder or asserting the ?folder= param; alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js and Anomaly/anomaly-detection.spec.js create anomaly configs with no folder assertion; slo-crud.spec.js creates SLOs with no folder assertion; alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js covers folder MOVE/search, not scoped creation. The diff changes where objects land (anomaly create/import now sends ?folder=; SLO edit now round-trips folder_id), so a dedicated Alerts spec is the least-duplicative home. Secondary SLO folder-scoping is noted in the plan for the SLO area, not crammed here.
